# Refund policy (2023)

**Deprecated.** Replaced by the [current refund policy](refund-policy.md). Kept for history only.

## Refund window
All plans: a full refund within 30 days of purchase. No proration. See [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Exceptions
None beyond billing errors.
